description: Paid ($0.10 USD). Bundle: how big and how busy the XRP Ledger is, in one call and one payment. Funded accounts and daily active accounts and transactions with 7 and 30-day changes, ledger object counts, XRP supply (circulating, escrowed, burned), XRP and RLUSD payment volume (XR-Telemetry) and on-ledger sell impact. Returns summary, key_numbers and sections; each section says ok, stale or unreadable.

sections.description: Comma-separated sections to return: network, ledger_objects, settlement, liquidity. Omit for all. summary and key_numbers always come back.
